intent.proves: At least one assortment permission grants an existing assortment to a user or group that exists.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomAssortmentPermissions p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomAssortments a WHERE a.AssortmentID = p.AssortmentPermissionAssortmentID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccessUser u WHERE u.AccessUserId = p.AssortmentPermissionAccessUserID)
